item.title: Worley Consulting and Bloomfire partner to bring Enterprise Intelligence to energy, chemicals and resources sectors
item.description: Enterprise Intelligence centralizes and organizes critical company information, making it easier for organizations to apply collective expertise.

item.title: Second largest earthquake in state history shakes north Louisiana
item.description: At this time no reports of injuries or facility damage.

item.title: Industrial Scientific Acquires Aeroqual
item.description: Industrial Scientific, a Fortive division, acquired Aeroqual to enhance real-time air quality monitoring. The move strengthens worker safety solutions, integrating advanced environmental sensing to help ensure every worker returns home safely.

item.title: Texas grid sees 233 GW in data center requests: How much is real?
item.description: Grid planners are drowning in connection requests. More than 233 GW of large-load interconnection applications now sit in ERCOT’s queue, with over 70% coming from data centers.

item.title: Zelestra proceeds with the construction of the Echols Grove and Cedar Range solar projects in Texas
item.description: Zelestra, a global, multi-technology, customer-focused renewable energy company, has commenced construction on their two largest solar projects to date in the U.S.

item.title: Avantus closes over $300 million in construction financing with BBVA and CIBC for Kitt solar and energy storage project
item.description: Avantus has closed a financing package of more than $300 million with Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria (BBVA) and Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce, New York Branch (CIBC) for the Kitt Solar and Energy Storage Project (Kitt).

item.title: Oklo, Centrus announce planned joint venture to advance nuclear fuel services in Ohio
item.description: Activities under this joint venture would occur at Centrus' Piketon site in Pike County, southern Ohio, co-located with Centrus' enrichment operations and adjacent to Oklo's planned 1.2 GW power campus.

item.title: Oil prices hit highest since 2022 at more than $119 a barrel on Iran war
item.description: That was well above its previous summit of around $23 in March 2022 in the early weeks of the Russia-Ukraine war.

item.title: Glenfarne’s Texas LNG and Kiewit execute lump-sum turnkey EPC contract
item.description: Under the terms of the agreement, Kiewit will perform the engineering, procurement of equipment, module fabrication, construction and commissioning for the full Texas LNG facility and deliver a fully completed and operational facility to Glenfarne.

item.title: U.S. gasoline export increased slightly in 2025
item.description: As in previous years, Mexico was the most popular destination.
